details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing significant selling pressure, with Bitcoin dipping below $63,000. This downturn is largely influenced by the anticipated IPO of AI firm Anthropic, which analysts speculate could draw capital away from crypto. Adding to the bearish sentiment are hawkish comments from Fed Governor Christopher Waller, who suggested a "shock" 50-basis-point interest rate hike in December to combat persistent inflation. US spot Bitcoin ETFs have also recorded considerable outflows, contributing to the "Fear and Greed Index" plunging into "Extreme Fear." Bitcoin has seen a decline of approximately 1.3% to 3% in the last 24 hours.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $63K on Anthropic IPO Fears & Hawkish Fed Remarks

details: Digital asset manager CoinShares has sold its entire corporate Ethereum treasury position, valued at $16.6 million, and half of its Solana holdings, worth $2.7 million, totaling $19.3 million. These sales are intended to help finance a $40 million share repurchase program approved by its board on October 22, 2026. The company also reported a 27% annual rise in third-quarter net profit, reaching $39.6 million, with assets under management recovering to $7.4 billion.
title: CoinShares Sells ETH & Solana for $40M Buyback Amid Q3 Profit Rise

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin is re-emphasizing the core value proposition of ETH, stating that its worth primarily comes from its stability, decentralization, censorship resistance, and security, rather than solely from the fee-burning mechanism that popularized the "ultrasound money" narrative. Buterin believes that stability will be a highly valued characteristic in the evolving era of AI disruption, advocating for ETH's role as a reliable financial infrastructure.
title: Vitalik Buterin Shifts ETH Narrative to Stability Over 'Ultrasound Money'

details: Singapore-headquartered payment institution FOMO Pay has announced a partnership with Anchorage Digital to integrate regulated US stablecoin infrastructure. This collaboration aims to connect US stablecoin issuance, minting, redemption, and trading services with payment and settlement use cases across Asia and the Middle East. FOMO Pay is notably the first Singaporean institution to be onboarded to Anchorage Digital's US platform, signaling a step towards broader institutional adoption of stablecoins for cross-border transactions.
title: FOMO Pay & Anchorage Digital Partner for Asia/ME Stablecoin Infrastructure

details: The market value of Nvidia-linked tokenized stocks experienced a significant jump of 159% to $401.9 million between November 8 and November 12, 2026. This surge occurred even as Nvidia's Nasdaq-listed shares dropped nearly 17% following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang. The divergence highlights that blockchain-based versions of listed shares can exhibit independent growth dynamics from the underlying stock. Concurrently, Nvidia reported stronger-than-expected Q3 revenue, surpassing forecasts.
title: Tokenized Nvidia Surges 159% Despite Stock Dip After CEO Exit
